title: A page template both sites set is one row and a conflict, never two rows
steps: Run the real MariaDB case of a page template both sites added, under one meta_id and two.
expect: One _wp_page_template row per page; the copy's value stays and the clash is a conflict.
A decision for the live side takes its template, still one row.
The same value on both sides merges with no conflict; a multi-valued key keeps both rows.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=page template both sites set on one page
tests: a page template both sites set on one page is one row, a conflict, never two rows — under one meta_id or two (#118)
